name: Hemp Seeds
siboNotes: Hemp seeds are well-tolerated and provide beneficial omega-3 fatty acids that may support gut health and reduce inflammation.
preparationTips: Store in refrigerator after opening to prevent rancidity
Add to smoothies, yogurt, or salads for extra protein and healthy fats
Toast lightly in a dry pan for enhanced nutty flavor
Can be ground into hemp seed butter for spreading
nutritionalHighlights: Complete protein with all essential amino acids
Rich in omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids
Good source of magnesium and iron
